title: Which Bible Story Are You Living Through Right Now?
subtitle: Exodus? Wilderness? Resurrection? Find the chapter you're in.

questions.text: What's the dominant feeling in your week?

options.text: Stuck between Pharaoh and a sea.
Wandering in a dry place I can't escape.
Surrounded by something that could end me.
Watching God breathe life back into something I'd buried.

questions.text: What is God most clearly doing?

options.text: Parting waters in front of me.
Humbling me — teaching me what was in my heart.
Closing the mouths of things that should've devoured me.
Showing me He is the resurrection and the life.

questions.text: Pick the moment that feels most like now:

options.text: Take off your shoes — this ground is holy.
Tongues of fire and people speaking new languages.
Wind and waves louder than my voice.
An angel telling me to keep walking.

questions.text: When you pray right now, you most often say...

options.text: Lord, fight for me — I'll hold my peace.
Lead me through. Don't let me lose heart.
Send Your angel. Shut the lions' mouths.
Peace, be still — in me, in this storm.

questions.text: How is God speaking to you?

options.text: Through fire in a burning bush — He's calling me by name.
Through Spirit — power I've never had before.
Through resurrection — He's raising what I gave up on.
Through silence in the wilderness.
March forward — even though the sea hasn't moved yet.
Take off my shoes — this is holy ground.
Open the upper room and wait.
Wake Jesus up — He's in the boat the whole time.

questions.text: What kind of God do you most need right now?

options.text: A deliverer.
A guide.
A rescuer who closes lions' mouths.
A resurrector.

questions.text: Pick the verse you keep coming back to:

options.text: The Lord shall fight for you.
Remember all the way the Lord led you.
I am the resurrection and the life.
Peace, be still.

exodus.name: Crossing the Red Sea
exodus.description: You're stuck between what was and what will be — and God is about to split a sea you've been staring at. Hold your peace. He's fighting for you.

wilderness.name: Wilderness Season
wilderness.description: This isn't punishment — it's formation. God's using the dry place to show you what's in your heart and to teach you how to live on manna instead of certainty.

lions-den.name: In the Lions' Den
lions-den.description: You're in a room that should've ended you, and you kept your knees bent toward home. God is sending the angel who shuts the mouths that wanted to eat you.

resurrection.name: Resurrection Morning
resurrection.description: You watched something die — a dream, a relationship, a version of yourself — and God is rolling the stone away. He didn't just want it to live; He wanted you to see who has the power to raise it.

burning-bush.name: At the Burning Bush
burning-bush.description: God is calling you by name in a place you didn't expect Him to. Take off your shoes — and then start arguing about it, like every prophet has. He'll still send you.

pentecost.name: Pentecost Power
pentecost.description: The Spirit is filling rooms you thought were empty. You've been waiting in an upper room, and now you're being sent out — with words and courage you didn't have a week ago.

storm-at-sea.name: Storm on the Sea of Galilee
storm-at-sea.description: The waves are louder than your prayers, and you're wondering if Jesus is asleep. He's in the boat. When He stands up, the storm sits down.
